{
  "version": "policy-v1",
  "about": "Every threshold the Flock and the record read, one file: `flock` holds the Flock's cells and `publish` the self-merge and probe cells record.mjs reads. A threshold is chosen on the record's readings and never tuned live; each carries the n and the window it was read over, or says in terms that it was not read. No default flips under n = 5 runs / 20 tasks: a threshold read under that floor is an `experiment` with its `rollback` named.",
  "publish": {
    "self_merge": {
      "enabled": true,
      "max_refolds": 3,
      "mergeable_wait_seconds": 120,
      "n": 0,
      "window": "none",
      "basis": "judgment",
      "experiment": true,
      "rollback": "enabled = false"
    },
    "probe": {
      "enabled": true,
      "timeout_seconds": 600,
      "n": 0,
      "window": "none",
      "basis": "judgment",
      "experiment": true,
      "rollback": "enabled = false",
      "unread": "publish-as-probe (#835): deploy, live verify and rollback after the self-merge; pre-registered reading per release: publishes per run, verify reds, rollbacks and deploy seconds against timeout_seconds"
    }
  },
  "flock": {
    "pulls": {
      "mode": "all",
      "n": 0,
      "window": "none",
      "basis": "judgment",
      "experiment": true,
      "rollback": "mode = all",
      "unread": "narrow pulls (#1292): cache reads and wall per run against the round-3 arm"
    },
    "jev_step": {
      "mode": "record",
      "n": 0,
      "window": "none",
      "basis": "judgment",
      "experiment": true,
      "rollback": "mode = off",
      "unread": "per-step Jev readings joined to the operator's smoke (state-probe runner spec §10)"
    },
    "jev_resolve": {
      "mode": "record",
      "n": 0,
      "window": "none",
      "basis": "judgment",
      "experiment": true,
      "rollback": "mode = off",
      "unread": "the jev:resolve answers against whether the R: task's session then edited the path (its edit rows), over 5 runs with a resolve task; Atlas: every resolve task changed nothing (n=5 runs)"
    },
    "jev_release": {
      "mode": "record",
      "n": 0,
      "window": "none",
      "basis": "judgment",
      "experiment": true,
      "rollback": "mode = off",
      "unread": "the jev:release answers against whether the task was later done or parked, over 20 given-back tasks; run-252: ~1,150 give-backs of one task, $80.57"
    },
    "scope": {
      "mode": "enforce",
      "n": 0,
      "window": "none",
      "basis": "run-247",
      "experiment": true,
      "rollback": "mode = record",
      "unread": "scope:outside refusals and driver:amendment rows per run (#1322: a green run merged a corrupted file no task listed)"
    },
    "stall": {
      "minutes": 20,
      "n": 7,
      "window": "the 7 Flock runs 247, 251–255 and radio-station run-1 (2026-09-26..28)",
      "basis": "the longest wait for a rise in the green count was 2.0 min; run-252 ran 229.7 min after its last rise",
      "experiment": true,
      "rollback": "minutes = 0",
      "unread": "stall:no-progress rows per run and the wall a stalled run no longer spends (#1334)"
    },
    "surface": {
      "min_confidence": 0.8,
      "n": 4,
      "window": "4 builder beliefs over 5 Flock runs 247, 252, 257 and radio-station run-1 and run-2 (2026-09-26..28)",
      "basis": "all 4 builder beliefs were at 0.85 or more and correct; run-252's named the cause #1330 fixed",
      "experiment": true,
      "rollback": "min_confidence = 2",
      "unread": "engine beliefs surfaced per run and how many named a real engine fault"
    }
  }
}
